description: The CAMBER Pilot 2 simulation evaluates camera-equipped roadside infrastructure for cooperative vehicle perception at a Trikala pedestrian crossing. CARLA varies weather and illumination and compares whether the vehicle processes roadside environmental-notification messages. The described deposit provides representative ego-vehicle and roadside-camera recordings, with or without visualized detections, for the scenario identified as 4.1. The broad title also mentions lane detection and safety metrics, but the full description specifically documents these camera recordings. Numeric metrics and annotation-file availability are therefore not assumed. These are simulation outputs; no media or individual frames were retrieved. The named source creators provide this metadata through Zenodo, whose deposits declare CC BY 4.0. Access restrictions and underlying provider terms remain separate from that declaration; cost is unknown unless explicitly stated. Geographic and temporal coverage are limited to the source-described roads, scenarios or periods. Metadata only was reviewed, with no files, measurements, imagery, archives or document bodies downloaded. Related components retain their distinct native identities and possible overlap. The described physical assets, observations or simulator outputs support road infrastructure simulation within these stated limits.
